name: aib_compare
description: Two runs: paired deltas with 95% bootstrap CIs. Three or more: a sweep ranked on a cost-accuracy frontier. Refused when the manifests differ in more than `vary` names.

items.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

vary.description: Manifest paths allowed to differ, as dotted-path globs (`agents.*.metadata.model`, or `model`).

name: aib_derive_agent_config
description: Derive a new arm from `base` with a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) and write it to suites/agents/experiments/<name>.yaml with a header naming the base, the change and the hypothesis. Refused when the patch changes more than one config path (a whole added block counts as one), when the result does not build, or when the name exists.

base.description: Config name of the arm to start from.

agent.description: Agent kind the config is built as: semantics, intent, genui, hybrid or prepared.

patch.description: JSON merge patch; null removes a key.

name.description: Name of the new arm (lowercase, digits, _ . -).

hypothesis.description: What the change should do, and which metric would show it.

name: aib_describe_run
description: A run: manifest, config blocks, judge, and which episodes are done, faulted, truncated or missing.

run.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

name: aib_describe_suite
description: A suite's tasks: id, title, instruction, tags, language, budget, optimalSteps. No ground truth.

suite.description: Suite name as aib_list_suites names it (e.g. "todo_v2"), or a .yaml path.

name: aib_diff_agent_configs
description: Differences between two arms: by config path, and the manifest paths `aib_compare` would need in `vary` for runs of them.

agent.description: Agent kind the config is built as: semantics, intent, genui, hybrid or prepared.

name: aib_doctor
description: Preflight: suite loads, Ollama up with the pinned models, API keys present (reported as present or not, never their value).

suite.description: Suite name as aib_list_suites names it (e.g. "todo_v2"), or a .yaml path.

name: aib_evaluate
description: Score a run: aggregates, per-episode verdicts. Without `judge`, rubric verdicts are reused from verdicts.json and nothing is written; a run that needs a judge and has none stored is refused. With `judge: true` the run is scored by the judge pinned for its suite, as a job (see aib_job_status); a priced judge needs maxUsd.

run.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

judge.description: Score with the suite's pinned judge (a job).

maxUsd.description: Spend cap for a priced judge.

name: aib_holdout_score
description: Score an arm on the suite's holdout: a person approves every call, the arm runs on the held-out tasks as a job, and only the suite-level score comes back. The call and the score are journaled to the open study.

agent.description: Agent kind the config is built as: semantics, intent, genui, hybrid or prepared.

suite.description: Suite name as aib_list_suites names it (e.g. "todo_v2"), or a .yaml path.

name: aib_job_cancel
description: Stop a job. A cancelled run keeps its directory; start it again with the same `out` to resume.

name: aib_job_log
description: The last lines of a job's output.

name: aib_job_status
description: A job: state, episodes done of planned, spend, run directory, error, and its result once finished.

name: aib_job_wait
description: Wait until a job ends or `seconds` pass (default 60, at most 600), sending progress notifications meanwhile.

name: aib_jobs
description: Every job of this server, newest first, and the configured runners and hosts.

name: aib_list_agent_configs
description: Agent configs (arms) with their header comment, blocks and hash. Derived arms are named experiments/<name>.

filter.description: Substring to match anywhere in the entry.

name: aib_list_runs
description: Run directories under results/ and experiments/, newest first: suite, agents, repetitions, trace count, whether evaluated.

suite.description: Suite name as the manifest records it.

since.description: ISO date; runs created before it are left out.

name: aib_list_suites
description: Task suites with task counts, tags, languages and criterion kinds.

name: aib_metrics_catalog
description: Every metric: name, unit, source (builtin or the provider that adds it), description.

name: aib_provenance
description: What a run was, in the fields that decide whether another compares with it; with `against`, what differs.

run.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

against.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

name: aib_read_agent_config
description: One agent config: its YAML, the parsed config, and per-block hashes.

name.description: Config name as aib_list_agent_configs names it.

name: aib_replay_thresholds
description: Replay a decision threshold from a recorded run instead of re-running it. `route` is exact and needs the always-local and always-cloud runs that price each route. `completion`, `guard` and `select-*` are counterfactual, first decision only: episodes where a decision would have gone the other way are counted, not scored.

run.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

decision.description: route, completion, guard, select-tools, select-listings, select-rows or select-*.

local.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

cloud.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

name: aib_report
description: Render reports into the run directory (md, json, csv, html) and return the Markdown report.

run.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

name: aib_route
description: Score routing deciders against the per-task oracle of an always-local and an always-cloud run, split by language.

local.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

cloud.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

items.description: Run directory relative to the checkout, as aib_list_runs names it.

name: aib_run_estimate
description: What a run would take: episodes, model hosts, priced models, and — from earlier runs of the same arm, or of its base — tokens, cost range and wall clock.

runner.description: Runner recipe from aib_mcp.yaml (aib_jobs lists them).

config.description: Agent config name, as aib_list_agent_configs names it.

agent.description: Agent kind the config is built as: semantics, intent, genui, hybrid or prepared.

suite.description: Suite name as aib_list_suites names it (e.g. "todo_v2"), or a .yaml path.

name: aib_run_start
description: Start a run as a job and return its id at once. Runs on the same model host queue behind each other. Naming an existing `out` resumes that run (complete episodes are reused). Priced models need maxUsd, an estimate under it and, above the auto-approve limit, a yes from the person at the client.

runner.description: Runner recipe from aib_mcp.yaml (aib_jobs lists them).

config.description: Agent config name, as aib_list_agent_configs names it.

agent.description: Agent kind the config is built as: semantics, intent, genui, hybrid or prepared.

suite.description: Suite name as aib_list_suites names it (e.g. "todo_v2"), or a .yaml path.

maxUsd.description: Spend cap; the job stops when it is reached.

out.description: Run directory name under results/; an existing one is resumed.

name: aib_selftest
description: Check a suite's oracles on the mock environment: each reference must pass, stopping at once must not.

suite.description: Suite name as aib_list_suites names it (e.g. "todo_v2"), or a .yaml path.

reference.description: Reference trajectories (ScriptedAgent config), path relative to the checkout.

name: aib_study
description: Open a tuning study (experiments/<name>/journal.jsonl), or reopen one. Derived arms, runs, comparisons, replays and holdout scores of this session are journaled to it with their hypotheses; comparisons report how many arms the study has tried.

hypothesis.description: What the study sets out to show; required for a new study.

name: aib_sweep_start
description: Sweep one config path over `values`: derives one arm per value from `base` (a value equal to the base uses the base), runs each on the tuning split, scores them with the pinned judge where the suite needs one, and finishes with a comparison of all arms. Returns the sweep job; the run jobs queue on their model host.

base.description: Config name of the arm to sweep from.

agent.description: Agent kind the config is built as: semantics, intent, genui, hybrid or prepared.

suite.description: Suite name as aib_list_suites names it (e.g. "todo_v2"), or a .yaml path.

name: aib_validate_agent_config
description: Build an agent config without running it: built or the refusal, block hashes, decision model. Pass a config name or inline YAML.

agent.description: Agent kind the config is built as: semantics, intent, genui, hybrid or prepared.

name.description: Config name as aib_list_agent_configs names it.

name: aib_validate_suite
description: Schema check of a suite: errors, warnings, task count, tags, languages.

suite.description: Suite name as aib_list_suites names it (e.g. "todo_v2"), or a .yaml path.
